newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks open higher as buying continues.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks open higher as buying continues.

text.p: Dhaka stocks opened higher on Sunday as both retail and institutional investors maintained their buying interest for a fifth straight session, brokers said.
"The current uptrend (in prices) is bringing back the investors," said one broker.
Aziz Pipes gained 34 taka to 995, Olympic Industries rose 14 to 470 and Bata Shoe was up seven to 145.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index closed 20.59 points or 2.15 percent up at 978.07 on a turnover of 41 million taka on Saturday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
